title: Harry Edison's real tenure in the Cleveland band
summary: Edison was not in the big band but in the seven-piece band in Cleveland in 1933-34.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Now, here's a mistake here. Harry Edison was not in the band.
Right, he wasn't in that band.
The first time you came in with Harry Edison is when you had the little band in Cleveland.
You see, Harry told me that in London and he told the press that in London; they had a press conference. At that time I didn't remember, but now I do, after reflecting on it.
